title: tooling(ui-merge): governance in-repo — liveness evidence and spec tests stop citing objectui by commit, one sdui-parser, AGENTS.md / pm scripts drop `objectui#`, `ui/AGENTS.md` nests, 18 governance workflows merged or retired (parent #25677, 4b/6)
body:
Filing gate ④: sub-issue 4b/6 of the epic #25677 (`pm:epic`; epic PM `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`). Part of #25677. ⛔ Not a claim. Item 4 of the parent is split in two at filing: 4a = #25711, release and publish (fixed group, Console build, pin scripts); 4b (this card) = everything that today encodes "objectui is another repository" in this repo's governance.

Blocked-by: #25685 (merging now) for anything that runs against the `ui/` tree; the inert parts (pm scripts learning `ui/**`, the governed-surface register) can land before cutover like PR A of #25697. Input: the roster table on #25697 (comment 6388182608).

**Who does it, where it lands:** the epic PM dispatches it (os-dev, objectstack checkout). Two PRs to **objectstack-ai/objectstack `main`**: PR 1 inert (pm scripts, governed-surface register for `ui/**`, dispatch-gates — lands before cutover; Tier S/H as the paths decide); PR 2 cutover-window (liveness evidence, spec tests, sdui-parser merge, `AGENTS.md` + `ui/AGENTS.md`, workflow deletions under `ui/.github/`; Tier H: `AGENTS.md`, `.github/workflows/**`).

## 维护者速读

两仓并成一仓后,本仓里所有"objectui 在另一个仓"的记法都要改:liveness 账本里 185 条 `evidenceScope: cross-repo` 证据有一部分是「objectui @某提交 的某文件某行」(另一部分指 cloud 仓,不动),合并后直接写仓内路径 `ui/...`,不再钉提交、不再续日期;161 个 spec 测试文件提到 objectui,其中真的去读 objectui 克隆/钉的改读 `ui/`,只是文字提到的不动;`sdui-parser` 两边各一份加一个 lockstep 检查,合并后留一份、删检查;`AGENTS.md` 里 41 处 `objectui#` 跨仓约定、pm 脚本里按仓分表的 `objectui` 行、`domain:ui` 车道,都并入本仓;objectui 自己的 `AGENTS.md` 变成 `ui/AGENTS.md`(嵌套,只管 `ui/` 下);objectui 28 个 workflow 里 18 个治理类的,按 #25697 的去向表逐个并入本仓同类 workflow 或删除(嵌套的 `ui/.github/` GitHub 本来就不会执行)。`AGENTS.md` 和 workflow 是受管面,按 Tier H 由你批准。

## Scope

1. **Liveness ledger.** `packages/spec/liveness/*.json`: of the 185 `"evidenceScope": "cross-repo"` entries, those whose evidence names objectui (`objectui @<sha>: path#symbol`) are rewritten to in-repo evidence (`ui/<path>#<symbol>`, scope per the README's in-repo value); entries naming `cloud @<sha>` stay cross-repo. The reader (`scripts/liveness-*.mjs`, README §evidenceScope) stops treating `ui/` as a foreign realm and resolves the paths like any in-repo path (exist-or-fail). The dev reports the split (objectui rows / cloud rows / mixed) before rewriting.
2. **Spec tests that read objectui.** Of the 161 `packages/spec/**/*.test.ts` files mentioning objectui, classify: (a) read the objectui tree through a clone, the pin or `objectui-lockstep.json` → read `ui/` directly; (b) textual mention in a comment or fixture name → unchanged. `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` and `scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs` / `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` / `gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` / `sdui-manifest.record.json` go with item 3.
3. **One sdui-parser.** `packages/sdui-parser` (`@objectstack/sdui-parser`) and `ui/packages/sdui-parser` are two copies kept in lockstep by a gate. Keep one (the dev proposes which, with the import graph on both sides; the published `@objectstack/sdui-parser` name is the default to keep), make the other a re-export or delete it, delete the lockstep gate and manifest record. Assessment item P5.
4. **`AGENTS.md`, `ui/AGENTS.md`, pm scripts.** `AGENTS.md`: the 41 `objectui#` mentions and every "sibling repo" instruction (the `../objectui` checkout, the pin bump procedure, cross-repo card references) become in-repo instructions or are deleted; `domain:ui` joins this repo's lane table. objectui's `AGENTS.md` becomes `ui/AGENTS.md`, scoped to `ui/` and pointing up for anything repo-wide (rules that duplicate the root file are deleted, not restated). `scripts/pm/**`: `GOVERNED_REPOS` / `check-governed-merges.mjs` register learns which `ui/**` paths are governed (`ui/.claude/**`, `ui/skills/**`, `ui/AGENTS.md` by the same two-tier rule); the fleet relay's per-repo rows for `objectui` stay until the repo is archived (sub-issue 5) and are removed in sub-issue 6; `dispatch-gates.mjs` derives `ui/` gates.
5. **The 18 governance workflows** (roster rows 1–6, 8–15, 20, 24, 25, 28 on #25697): for each, one of — fold into the objectstack counterpart (board-snapshot, changelog, changeset-guard, changeset-presence, check-links, cross-repo-issue-closer, dependabot-auto-merge, governed-surface-guard, half-state-patrol, hook-selftests, labeler, merge-queue-head-patrol, required-check-set-patrol, test-shard-timings-refresh) widening it to `ui/**`; or port as a new objectstack workflow (line-citation-gate, repo-gates' doc/skill gates if they have no counterpart); or delete (anything the merge makes meaningless). `ui/.github/` is deleted at the end of PR 2 — nested workflow files never run. `ui/.claude/hooks` (8 hooks) and `ui/.githooks`: merge into the root hooks or delete, with the hook self-tests covering what remains. `docs-deploy.yml` for objectui's site: keep as a second deploy job in this repo's `docs-deploy.yml` (the site stays a separate Vercel project) — the project id/secrets are the maintainer's.

## Verification (the dev's)

- PR 1 on `main` as it is: every derived gate green; `check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test` and the queue guard self-tests pin the new `ui/**` rows.
- PR 2 on the `DO NOT MERGE` verification branch of #25697: liveness reader green with zero objectui-citing cross-repo rows; the reclassified spec tests pass reading `ui/`; sdui-parser's consumers on both sides build and test against the kept copy; `AGENTS.md` gates (`check:agents-*`, line citations) green; hook self-tests green over the merged hook set; no workflow under `ui/.github/` remains.
- A table on this card: each of the 18 workflows → its disposition and the PR hunk that implements it.

## Done when

- PR 1 merged before cutover; PR 2 green on the verification branch, approved by `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, handed to sub-issue 5 and merged in the cutover window after the subtree PR.
- `git grep -c 'objectui @' packages/spec/liveness` is 0; `git grep -l 'objectui#' AGENTS.md` is empty; one sdui-parser package; `ui/.github/` absent.

**Size:** XL — the PM may split PR 2 by item if the diff crosses 3000 lines (the human-merge line applies either way). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## 风险

- Liveness semantics: rewriting evidence must not silently upgrade a stale cross-repo claim to a fresh in-repo one; the dev keeps `verifiedAt` as it is and lets the ledger's own staleness worklist re-date them.
- `AGENTS.md` is read by every seat: PR 2's `AGENTS.md` hunk is reviewed against the pm-dispatch skill for contradictions before the maintainer sees it.
- Two hook trees with overlapping names: a merged pre-commit must not run objectui's root-assuming hooks against objectstack paths — `uiRoot()` from #25685 is the guard.

## Dedupe

Open issues list 2026-10-24 23:05Z (REST, `state=open` 100 most recent) filtered on liveness / sdui / AGENTS / governance / objectui: only this epic's own cards and #25556 (superseded at sub-issue 6). Assessment item P5 (sdui-parser lockstep) is carried here rather than filed on its own. **New.**
